sources.title: Bundesmeldegesetz (BMG) § 17 Anmeldung, Abmeldung
verified_claims: Whoever moves into a dwelling must register with the registration authority within two weeks of moving in.
Whoever moves out of a dwelling and does not move into a new dwelling in Germany must deregister within two weeks of moving out.

sources.title: Bundesmeldegesetz (BMG) § 19 Mitwirkung des Wohnungsgebers
verified_claims: The landlord (Wohnungsgeber) must confirm the move-in in writing or electronically within the § 17(1) deadline.
The confirmation contains landlord name/address, owner name if different, move-in date, address, names of persons registering.
If the landlord does not provide it, the person registering must inform the registration authority without delay.

sources.title: BMI – Meldewesen
verified_claims: Federal overview page on residence registration exists at this URL.

sources.title: Wohnsitz – Alleinige Wohnung oder Hauptwohnung anmelden (Service Berlin)
verified_claims: Register within 14 days of moving into a primary or sole residence in Berlin.
A Wohnungsgeberbestätigung and the registration form are required; appointment at a Bürgeramt, in person or by proxy.

sources.title: Abmeldung einer Wohnung (Service Berlin)
verified_claims: Berlin service page for deregistering a dwelling exists at this URL.

sources.title: Residence permit for the purpose of full-time studies (Service Berlin)
verified_claims: Granted for full-time studies at a state-recognised university; includes preparatory measures and compulsory internships.
Generally granted and extended for two years; allows 140 full working days per calendar year.
Enrolment or conditional admission is required.
Apply online ('Application for a residence permit for language and study purposes'); the authority contacts you and may invite you to an in-person appointment with original documents.

sources.title: Fiktionsbescheinigung (Fictional Certificate) (Service Berlin)
verified_claims: Berlin service page for the fictional certificate exists at this URL.

sources.title: Elektronischer Aufenthaltstitel (eAT) – Ausgabe (Service Berlin)
verified_claims: The PIN letter is handed out when the eAT is ordered.
The card can usually be handed out about 4–5 weeks after ordering.
Collection is possible by an authorised person aged at least 14; bring passport and any previous eAT.
Collection must be at the authority that ordered the card.

sources.title: Residence permit for spouses and children of skilled workers, students, trainees, scientists and teachers (Service Berlin)
verified_claims: Berlin service page for family members of students exists at this URL.

sources.title: Wohnsitzanmeldung – Landeshauptstadt München
verified_claims: The law provides 14 days for registration.
Registration is possible online (main residence only) or in person at a Bürgerbüro.

sources.title: Wohnsitz abmelden – Landeshauptstadt München
verified_claims: Munich service page for deregistration exists at this URL.

sources.title: Aufenthaltserlaubnis – Studium (Landeshauptstadt München)
sources.authority: Landeshauptstadt München – Servicestelle für Zuwanderung und Einbürgerung
verified_claims: Application form and documents can be submitted online or by post.
Requires admission to full-time studies at a state or state-recognised university or comparable institution.
Generally granted for three years (or the duration of studies if shorter) and can be extended.
Employment up to 140 days or 280 half-days per year in total, including student jobs.

sources.title: Aufenthaltserlaubnis – Studienvorbereitung (Landeshauptstadt München)
sources.authority: Landeshauptstadt München – Servicestelle für Zuwanderung und Einbürgerung
verified_claims: Munich service page for study-preparation residence permits exists at this URL.

sources.title: Aufenthaltsgesetz (AufenthG) § 16b Studium
verified_claims: Students from third countries may work 140 full days or 280 half days per year without approval of the Federal Employment Agency.
Student auxiliary jobs (studentische Nebentätigkeiten) are not counted towards this limit.

sources.title: Aufenthaltsgesetz (AufenthG) § 81 Beantragung des Aufenthaltstitels
verified_claims: If an extension or another residence title is applied for before the current title expires, the current title is deemed to continue until the authority decides (para. 4).
This does not apply to a Schengen visa under § 6(1).
A certificate of this effect (Fiktionsbescheinigung) is issued.

sources.title: Aufenthaltsverordnung (AufenthV) § 41 Vergünstigung für Angehörige bestimmter Staaten
verified_claims: Nationals of Australia, Israel, Japan, Canada, the Republic of Korea, New Zealand and the USA may enter without a visa and obtain the residence title in Germany.
The residence title must be applied for within three months after entry.

sources.title: BAMF-NAvI – Behörden
verified_claims: Search by postcode/place of residence to find the responsible foreigners' authority (Ausländerbehörde) and counselling services.

sources.title: Personalausweisportal – Der elektronische Aufenthaltstitel
verified_claims: Federal information page on the electronic residence permit card (eAT) exists at this URL.

sources.title: BZSt – Steuerliche Identifikationsnummer
verified_claims: The tax ID is assigned automatically on first registration in Germany once the registration office transmits the data, and is sent by post.
If it has not arrived three months after registration, a copy of the ID document and registration confirmation can be sent to the BZSt.

sources.title: BZSt – Identifikationsnummer – Fragen und Antworten
verified_claims: Official FAQ on the tax identification number; indicates typical delivery 3–4 weeks after assignment.

sources.title: Informationen für Studierende – Rundfunkbeitrag
verified_claims: One contribution per dwelling, regardless of the number of residents or devices.
In a shared flat (WG) one person registers and pays; residents decide who.
BAföG recipients can apply for exemption; the exemption does not extend to co-residents.

sources.title: Healthcare and Health Insurance – DAAD
verified_claims: Proof of health insurance is required for university enrolment and for the residence permit.
Students up to age 30 generally take out statutory health insurance at student rates; from 30 different rules and rates apply.
Relying on home-country insurance requires a certificate of exemption from a German statutory insurer.

sources.title: Die Einschreibung – DAAD
verified_claims: DAAD guidance on university enrolment (Einschreibung / Immatrikulation), including health-insurance proof.

sources.title: Study and work – Make it in Germany
sources.authority: Federal Government portal (Make it in Germany)
verified_claims: Federal portal page on working while studying (140 full / 280 half days).

sources.title: Ein Sperrkonto eröffnen und schließen – Auswärtiges Amt
verified_claims: Official page on opening and closing a blocked account; the blocked account pays out a fixed monthly amount.

sources.title: Versicherungsnummernachweis (Sozialversicherungsausweis) – Deutsche Rentenversicherung
verified_claims: The social insurance number is sent automatically when an employer first registers the employee with the statutory health insurer.
The number is assigned once and is valid for life; the certificate is free of charge.
If it does not arrive it can be requested from the Deutsche Rentenversicherung or the health insurer.
